answer: 关于父子数据集：现有原文证据没有说明 AdvHotpotQA 与 HotpotQA 之间存在父子或派生关系，因此该关联无直接依据 [E1, E3]。能确认的是 ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 上做实验，并指出该数据集使用 Wikipedia 作为非结构化知识源 [E1, E3]；HippoRAG 把 HotpotQA 作为评估数据集之一，但强调它因虚假信号而是较弱的多跳测试 [E9]。关于抽样方式：HippoRAG 明确从每个验证集抽取 1,000 个问题，并仿照 IRCoT 汇集所选问题的候选段落（含支持与干扰段落）形成每个数据集的检索语料 [E9]；ToG-2 侧未给出 AdvHotpotQA 的抽样方式，流程证据不足。关于检索知识来源：ToG-2 描述为混合 RAG，迭代地从非结构化与结构化知识源紧耦合检索，用 KG 连接文档、用文档作实体上下文 [E6]，并在 AdvHotpotQA 上实例说明三元组链接与文档上下文共同提供线索 [E5]；HippoRAG 侧则给出每个 1,000 题开发集的检索语料与抽取 KG 统计（段落数、唯一节点/边/三元组等）[E9]。两者是否共用同一知识图谱或同一语料，证据未说明，不能据此推断继承或公平胜负。

Results
We present our retrieval and QA experimental results below. Given that our method indirectly affects
QA performance, we report QA results on our best-performing retrieval backbone ColBERTv2 [70].
However, we report retrieval results for several strong single-step and multi-step retrieval techniques.
Single-Step Retrieval Results. As seen in Table 2, HippoRAG outperforms all other methods,
including recent LLM-augmented baselines such as Propositionizer and RAPTOR, on our main
datasets, MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA, while achieving competitive performance on HotpotQA.
We notice an impressive improvement of 11 and 20% for R@2 and R@5 on 2WikiMultiHopQA
and around 3% on MuSiQue. This difference can be partially explained by 2WikiMultiHopQA’s
entity-centric design, which is particularly well-suited for HippoRAG. Our lower performance on
HotpotQA is mainly due to its lower knowledge integration requirements, as explained in Appendix
B, as well as a due to a concept-context tradeoff which we alleviate with an ensembling technique
described in Appendix F.2.
Multi-Step Retrieval Results. For multi-step or iterative retrieval, our experiments in Table 3
demonstrate that IRCoT [78] and HippoRAG are complementary. Using HippoRAG as the re-
triever for IRCoT continues to bring R@5 improvements of around 4% for MuSiQue, 18% for
2WikiMultiHopQA and an additional 1% on HotpotQA.

To evaluate the contribution of each component in ToG-2, we conducted comprehensive ablation
experiments across WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en and FEVER. To conserve API costs,
we sampled a small subset of the FEVER dataset for ablation experiments. Compared to the per-
formance on the other three datasets, on WebQSP, the effectiveness of Topic Prune (TP) is more
pronounced, possibly due to the higher relative proportion of general entities in WebQSP questions,

brought relatively consistent improvements across each dataset, indicating that adaptive query opti-
mization can help the LLM better understand the tasks.

raw: {"premise_check":[{"premise":"HippoRAG 使用 HotpotQA 数据集","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E9","E4"],"note":"E9 明确将 HotpotQA 纳入评估并抽取验证集问题；E4 报告 HotpotQA 检索结果。"},{"premise":"ToG-2 使用 AdvHotpotQA 数据集","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E3","E5","E7"],"note":"多处实验在 AdvHotpotQA 上报告结果。"},{"premise":"AdvHotpotQA 是 HotpotQA 的父子/派生数据集关系在原文有直接说明","supported":false,"evidence_eids":[],"note":"证据中未出现 AdvHotpotQA 由 HotpotQA 派生或父子关系的描述；仅有 AdvHotpotQA 使用 Wikipedia 作为知识源（E1、E3）。"},{"premise":"两论文的 HotpotQA 抽样方式可直接比较","supported":false,"evidence_eids":["E9"],"note":"HippoRAG 说明从验证集抽取 1,000 题并按 IRCoT 汇集候选段落；ToG-2 证据未描述 AdvHotpotQA 的抽样方式，无法对应。"},{"premise":"检索知识来源可直接对照","supported":true,"evidence_eids":["E1","E3","E6","E9"],"note":"ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 使用 Wikipedia 作为知识源并联合 KG/文档；HippoRAG 构建段落检索语料与抽取 KG 统计。两者具体语料构建不同，证据未证明共享同一知识库。"}],"answer":"关于父子数据集：现有原文证据没有说明 AdvHotpotQA 与 HotpotQA 之间存在父子或派生关系，因此该关联无直接依据 [E1, E3]。能确认的是 ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 上做实验，并指出该数据集使用 Wikipedia 作为非结构化知识源 [E1, E3]；HippoRAG 把 HotpotQA 作为评估数据集之一，但强调它因虚假信号而是较弱的多跳测试 [E9]。关于抽样方式：HippoRAG 明确从每个验证集抽取 1,000 个问题，并仿照 IRCoT 汇集所选问题的候选段落（含支持与干扰段落）形成每个数据集的检索语料 [E9]；ToG-2 侧未给出 AdvHotpotQA 的抽样方式，流程证据不足。关于检索知识来源：ToG-2 描述为混合 RAG，迭代地从非结构化与结构化知识源紧耦合检索，用 KG 连接文档、用文档作实体上下文 [E6]，并在 AdvHotpotQA 上实例说明三元组链接与文档上下文共同提供线索 [E5]；HippoRAG 侧则给出每个 1,000 题开发集的检索语料与抽取 KG 统计（段落数、唯一节点/边/三元组等）[E9]。两者是否共用同一知识图谱或同一语料，证据未说明，不能据此推断继承或公平胜负。","citations":[{"eid":"E1","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E3","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E9","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E6","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E5","quote_id":"q1"},{"eid":"E9","quote_id":"q2"}],"status":"partial"}
